answer: Reputation relic carryover: each agent identity accumulates a transferable history token (a relic) that new clones cannot inherit, so fresh identities start with zero standing. Market access requires a minimum relic score, forcing attackers to build history per clone. A pearl of verified transaction history must accompany each bid; forged or copied pearls are detected by ferrous timestamp chains anchored across peers. Cost: months of genuine low-margin trades per clone, making mass sybils economically worse than one honest agent.
